text:
maria: FYI — bringing up Apollo customer LoRA (apollo-lora-v2) in staging quick-eval. Seeing numeric formatting regressions when using int4 (commas dropped). @chris @devon
chris: can you paste the eval id + a minimal failing example?
maria: eval: apollo-58. cmd: ```./rundev eval --pack apollo-quick-58 --model base-13b --adapter apollo-lora-v2 --quant int4``` example: Expected: "Total: $1,234.56"  Got: "Total: $1234.56"
devon: base-13b int4 alone ok? and adapter on fp16?
maria: base-13b int4 alone returns comma correctly. adapter on fp16 also fine. only adapter+int4 breaks.
akshat: likely embedding/token alignment + quant boundary issue. does LoRA add tokens?
maria: customer pipeline uses <AMT> but LoRA metadata claims no vocab changes.
jess: i'll add tokenizer diffs and synthetic amount cases to quick-eval. small PR incoming.
eval-bot: quick-eval apollo-58: pass 66/100, fails (numeric-format: 17). report: https://ci.internal/reports/apollo-58/fails.csv
chris: plan: 1) repro locally 2) try running adapter path at int8 (adapter-only int8) 3) inspect embedding weight deltas 4) add test. assign devon to weight diffs.
devon: taking it. will post weight-delta heatmap + top token overlaps in ~2h.
maria: ran adapter-int8-fallback quick-eval: pass 90/100, numeric fails down to 2. looks promising.
akshat: interim policy: prefer int8 for adapter path when quick-eval flags numeric-sensitive cases. long-term: clamp adapter deltas on punctuation embeddings or special-case during quantization.
maria: opening customer note and blocking rollout until we add unit tests + mitigation.
chris: thanks team. keep updates here :thumbsup:
